meanings: used in 家伙 and 家俱, home, family, (polite) my (sister, uncle etc), classifier for families or businesses, refers to the philosophical schools of pre-Han China, noun suffix for a specialist in some activity, such as a musician or revolutionary, corresponding to English -ist, -er, -ary or -ian

between, among, within a definite time or space, room, section of a room or lateral space between two pairs of pillars, classifier for rooms, gap, to separate, to thin out (seedlings), to sow discontent
to see, to meet, to appear (to be sth), to interview, opinion, view, to appear, also written 现
to meet; to see each other
to shout, to call, to order, to ask, to be called, by (indicates agent in the passive mood), variant of 叫
surname Jiao, to teach, religion, teaching, to make, to cause, to tell
to introduce (sb to sb), to give a presentation, to present (sb for a job etc), introduction
